name: Sober Minded
overview: Scripture calls believers to a mindset marked by sobriety and self-control, urging them to reject worldly patterns and instead be transformed by the renewing of their minds to discern God's perfect will (Romans 12:2). This sober-mindedness is characterized by vigilance, discretion, and temperance, as exemplified in the instruction for both aged men and young men to live with sound faith and godly behavior (Titus 2:2, 6, 12). Believers are also reminded to avoid excess and drunkenness, choosing instead to be filled with the Spirit, which empowers a sober and righteous life (Ephesians 5:18).
